doc.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001

title: Bert's own group at Birdland and the Bohemia
summary: His group with Duke Jordan and various drummers, and the Kaleidoscope album.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Right. You had your own, some Monday nights at Birdland.

Well for a while I had my own group. In other words, when I was going to school, you know that Manhattan School of Music, I got a group together. I had Duke Jordan on piano all the time and Vinnie Dean on alto, a variety of drummers. I had a lot of different drummers. Osie Johnson, Gus Johnson, Eddie Shaughnessy, Joe Morello. And I worked Birdland and The Bohemia and we worked around Connecticut and around Jersey. So in fact I did an album called “Kaleidoscope” which hasn’t been put out on CD, and that was that group. And it was — we had a lot of original material. I have some tapes that I did of that and which I’d like to get out too but so far I haven’t gotten them out.
